_comment: Posting channel config. CMS for blog publishing + social channels via Make.com webhook.

cms._comment: Blog publishing target. provider "none" = no CMS: publish-blog.py writes final HTML to outputs/blogs/ready/ for manual or GitHub publishing. Other providers (directus, strapi, contentful, webflow) POST to the CMS.

social._comment: Each channel posts via its `publisher` (default 'make' = the Make.com webhook). Optional `fallback_publisher` is tried automatically if the primary errors (script logs + notifies). Add cheaper publishers in `publishers` as needed.

publishers._comment: Registry of where channels can post. 'make' = Make.com webhook (Make routes by the channel field). Add a cheap fallback for the hard platforms when needed.

upload-post._comment: CHEAPEST fallback. upload-post.com free tier = 10 posts/month and covers the hard platforms TikTok/Threads/X plus IG/YouTube/FB/LinkedIn (it handles the platform app-approval for you). Sign up, put the API key in config/.upload-post-key, set enabled=true. Leave disabled until you actually need a hard platform.

instagram._note: Needs an IG Business/Creator account linked to a Facebook Page.

youtube._note: Video upload (Shorts/long). Needs a video asset from video-production.

tiktok._note: TikTok content API is restrictive; upload-post handles approval. Video required.

x_twitter._note: X API can be costly direct; upload-post covers it.

linkedin_personal._comment: LinkedIn PERSONAL video post (founder profile) - use a personal-voice caption

facebook_reel._comment: FB Reel (video). Host video on a crawler-friendly URL (see knowledge/DISTRIBUTION-GOTCHAS.md).

instagram_reel._comment: IG Reel video; Make route filters channel=instagram_reel

youtube_short._comment: YouTube Shorts; Make route does HTTP Get-a-File(video_url) -> YouTube Upload (Public). Title comes from the webhook 'title' field (<=100 chars).

schedule._comment: Cron-style schedules in LOCAL timezone. Adjust to your audience's peak engagement hour.

blog_draft_generation._comment: Daily 02:02 — generates 3 drafts for next day's publish

weekly_social_posting._comment: Tue 11:30 — fire social posts at audience peak engagement hour

email._comment: Email destination for email-marketing. Drafts staged here; the user sends. publisher/fallback like the social channels.
email._note: Authenticate the provider with your own account; the engine never logs in or imports lists.

distribution._comment: Publish stage used by the social-distribution skill: video/Reel hosting, optional Telegram approval gate, and timezone-aware scheduling. Make routing + channel values still come from social.publishers / social.channels.
distribution._video_host_comment: Crawler-friendly host the platform can fetch (a CMS with Disallow:/ in robots.txt makes Reels fail 422). 'catbox' = files.catbox.moe (free, no account). Or fix the CMS robots.txt to allow facebookexternalhit and set this to 'cms'.
distribution._ensure_fps_comment: Re-encode any video below 24fps to this before publishing (Reels reject <24fps).

approval._comment: Two-way Telegram approval BEFORE publishing. enabled=false -> publish at the slot with no human gate.

schedule._comment: Anchor publish times to the AUDIENCE timezone. days: 'daily' or a list of weekday abbrevs (Mon..Sun). time: 'HH:MM' local to timezone. Each key is a Make channel value (social.channels[*].channel_field_value).
schedule._two_reels_per_day_comment: To post 2 reels/day, enqueue two separate items (e.g. a morning and an evening bundle); the slot times control WHEN each channel publishes.

distribution._caption_files_comment: Per-platform captions: maps the channel value sent to Make -> caption file inside the --caption-dir bundle. Lets one render carry several voices (see knowledge/per-platform-captions.md).
